answer: Vouch-slot bond: a newcomer joins only with an established agent's vouch, staking 70 in one grove slot with a cipher-sealed receipt for key, epoch. Vouchers fill four slots max; newcomers pay 48. A rented-voucher ring faces the ripple: one fake re-audits the grove, each fake burns its bond, its voucher loses 70. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 slots: 48,000 plus 70,000 locked, 118,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 48 once and reclaims its bond.
